answer_1.quote: We carry out experiments on three large-scale translation tasks, WMT'14 English-to-German (En→De), WMT'19 Chinese-to-English (Zh→En) and WMT'14 English-to-French (En→Fr).
answer_1.outputs: Machine translations from source to target languages

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, in addition to the widely used BLEU, we also adopt the Comet which is recently a more welcomed metric.
